root_causes.description: product-catalog sustained ~2.94-3.17 CPU cores versus less than 0.03 cores on every peer service, indicating severe CPU saturation on product-catalog pods. As the shared leaf dependency of frontend, checkout and recommendation, its resource starvation propagates client-facing errors upward to the frontend edge.

evidence.expected_baseline: peer services checkout=0.028, frontend=0.020, payment=0.010, cart=0.004, shipping=0.001, recommendation=0.012 cores => expected <0.05 cores

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.002, p95=0.012, p99=0.018, max=0.019 errors/sec (only service with non-zero server error rate)

root_causes.description: frontend is the only service exhibiting server-side errors during the watchdog window, consistent with the HighClientErrorRate alert being raised at the frontend edge where calls to upstream dependencies fail.

evidence.expected_baseline: 0.000 (checkout, cart, payment, shipping, product-catalog, currency, email, quote all returned 0.000 in the same window)

root_causes.description: The product-catalog CPU saturation would inflate response latency on calls from frontend/checkout/recommendation, driving upstream client timeouts/errors while leaving product-catalog's own server error counters at zero.

evidence.observed_value: mean=34600448 bytes (~34MB), p99=42166026 bytes, no growth trend
evidence.expected_baseline: stable ~34MB; rules out memory_stress/OOM as the driver of the CPU anomaly
0 restarts; rules out pod_crash as the root cause

remediation_steps: Inspect product-catalog pod resource requests/limits and per-container CPU breakdown to confirm whether the ~3-core saturation is a runaway thread/GC loop or genuine load.
Raise product-catalog CPU limits or horizontally scale the deployment (HPA) to absorb load and relieve downstream call latency.
Rolling-restart the product-catalog deployment to clear any stuck CPU-bound process, then re-measure container_cpu_usage_seconds_total.
Verify frontend/checkout/recommendation client error rates return to 0.000 after product-catalog recovery.
